Q937.reason: Morphine is an opioid analgesic that lowers pain intensity and depresses the CNS, producing sedation and constipation.

Q922.reason: High-intensity fatigue occurs when ATP use outruns resynthesis; stored ATP lasts only seconds and ADP rises rather than falls.

Q992.reason: Common-law rape is a general-intent crime, so once nonconsent is found an honest but unreasonable belief in consent, even from voluntary intoxication, does not excuse the defendant.
